ProductionRecipe.Label: Gmsh-only production recipe (supervisor decisions 38-42, 2026-09-18/19): the coupon mesh is the Gmsh build alone - prism edge tubes on every straight metal edge (inner ring EdgeSize 0.25 nm, ring ratio 2 up to the transverse bound, extruded in layers following the size field on the axis within the tangential spacing, explicit pyramids), isotropic corner balls graded to the tube inner size (CornerSize = EdgeSize), trace-basis cut-surface / volume sizing at TraceBasisSizeRatio 0.5 (decision 42, calibrated by physics-11), junction-line / footprint band and tube-band volume size laws with FarGrowth 0.5 to FarSize; no MMG, no tetrahedral edge layer, no metric / adaptation / restoration stages; every physical gate (Gates) unchanged and re-expressed per element type
ProductionRecipe.Decision: SUPERVISOR-DECISIONS.md items 37 (prism tube spike), 38 (Gmsh-only pipeline), 39 (volume size laws), 40 (tube layers follow the size field), 41 (surface layer at on-box tube ends; two-variant sizing calibration) and 42 (TraceBasisSizeRatio 0.5 adopted)
ProductionRecipe.Binding: verify_canonical_case_entries.py and run_general_mesh_suite.py (general_mesh_manifest.validate_production_recipe_commands) require the recorded gmsh-build command of every production case to execute each option exactly once at its value - --trace-basis-size-ratio exactly once at 0.5 when the case binds a trace basis and never otherwise (run_gmsh_only_case.py takes the ratio from these options alone, no default) - and mesh_stage_contract.validate_gmsh_build_census requires --prism-tubes true; the tube record (InnerSize = --edge-size = CornerSize, GrowthRatio, TangentialSize = --lc-tangent, NormalSize = --lc-fine, FarSize = --lc-far, FarGrowth, rings, spacing, SectorDegrees = --tube-sector-degrees or its default 30, PyramidHeight = 0.5 x the outermost ring, prisms, pyramids, the decision-40 layer records within GrowthRatio with the decision-41 surface layer at every tube end on the box, size laws with RadialGrowth 1 and ProtectedDistance 2 x NormalSize, the decision-39 volume laws growing with FarGrowth with their achieved shell statistics, band curves at NormalSize spacing with the recorded junction first-layer sizes), the corner grading, the etch footprint, the junction segments, the trace basis sizing and the per-type quality gates are bound by mesh_stage_contract.validate_gmsh_build_census; the canonical cache key (CanonicalBuildId) does not encode recipe options

Parameters.EdgeSize: 0.25 nm: the tube's innermost ring size and the corner ball's CornerSize (one graded law)
Parameters.GrowthRatio: 2: ring ratio of the tube cross-section and of the corner shells
Parameters.TubeRings: largest K with r_K + h_K <= min(Overetch, MetalThickness / 2, CornerIsotropyRadius) (7 rings, radius 31.75 nm on the four/ten-edge process)
Parameters.TubeExtrusionSpacing: <= TangentialSize (0.05 um); the layer thickness follows the composed size field on the tube axis (decision 40: min of TangentialSize, the semantic-corner ball law, the trace-basis volume rule, the band rule and the corner-exterior rule; gradient-limited to (GrowthRatio - 1) / GrowthRatio, layers equidistributed in 1 / size, consecutive layers within GrowthRatio; at a tube end on the outer box the end layer is the field at the surface, at most the prescribed size there - decision 41; census PrismTubes.LayerRule / TubeAxisSizeLaw / LayerGrowthCap, LayerThickness.LayersBelowTangentialSizeOverGrowthRatio, per-tube Tubes[].LayerThickness with EndsOnBox; the largest layer is the recorded per-tube Spacing)
Parameters.TubeSectorDegrees: 30 (--tube-sector-degrees, mesher default; the census Section.SectorDegrees must equal the option or its default)
Parameters.TubePyramidHeight: 0.5 x outermost ring size (PyramidHeightOverOuterRing 0.5, mesher constant TUBE_PYRAMID_HEIGHT_OVER_OUTER_RING; the census PyramidHeight must equal 0.5 x the outermost RingSize)
Parameters.TubeCornerClearance: R / tan(phi / 2) + h_K before a semantic corner; the cap centre is a graded point of the corner law
Parameters.NormalSize: 0.25 x MetalThickness (--lc-fine); the size at the tube surface and on the feature-curve bands
Parameters.TangentialSize: 0.05 um (--lc-tangent): extrusion spacing and ridge grid
Parameters.FarGrowth: 0.5: growth of the tube band and of the feature-curve bands beyond ProtectedDistance = 2 x NormalSize
Parameters.RadialGrowth: 1.0: growth of the feature-curve band inside ProtectedDistance (mesher constant BAND_RADIAL_GROWTH; census SizeLaws.RadialGrowth)
Parameters.ProtectedDistance: 2 x NormalSize (mesher constant BAND_PROTECTED_DISTANCE_OVER_NORMAL; census SizeLaws.ProtectedDistance)
Parameters.TraceBasisVolumeGrowth: = FarGrowth (decision 39a): the trace rule is a volume law, size <= TraceBasisSizeRatio x the local basis edge + FarGrowth x the distance to the basis triangle (census TraceBasisSizing.GradingSlope and SizeLaws.TraceBasisVolumeGrowth; achieved shells in SizeLaws.Achieved.TraceApexes)
Parameters.CornerExteriorGrowth: = FarGrowth (decision 39b): outside a corner ball the size is NormalSize + FarGrowth x the distance beyond CornerIsotropyRadius from the nearest graded point (census SizeLaws.CornerExteriorGrowth / CornerExteriorRule; achieved shells in SizeLaws.Achieved.CornerExterior)
Parameters.JunctionVolumeLaw: the band law (NormalSize + RadialGrowth x min(r, ProtectedDistance) + FarGrowth beyond) on the junction lines throughout the volume (decision 39c; census SizeLaws.JunctionVolumeRule; achieved shells in SizeLaws.Achieved.JunctionLines)
Parameters.BandCurveSpacing: NormalSize: the non-metal longitudinal feature curves (junction lines, footprint edges parallel to a metal edge) are 1D-meshed at the band law's size on the line (census BandCurves.Spacing; achieved first-layer transverse sizes in Bands.JunctionFirstLayer, report only)
Parameters.TraceBasisSizeRatio: 0.5 (--trace-basis-size-ratio, decision 42; 1.0 before): cut-surface and volume trace law at half the local bound-basis edge (size <= 0.5 x the shortest edge of the nearest basis triangle + FarGrowth x the distance to it); dimensionless and contract-derived; calibrated by physics-11 (V-a) against physics-10 (ratio 1.0) and physics-12 (V-b TangentialSize 25 nm, rejected): E 60/60 within 1%, p_SA within 1/2/5% 35/44/58, p_MS median -0.60% worst -1.70%, p_MA converged (+0.76%), 0.508 node-h per coupon

DesignGate.Rule: the achieved-anisotropy design gate (Gates.MinimumAchievedAspect / Gates.MaximumNormalFactor, unchanged) is replaced under the Gmsh-only pipeline by the prism tube design statement (general_mesh_audit_producer.TUBE_DESIGN_GATE; general_mesh_manifest.tube_design_statement): the recorded rings and extrusion are the design, the audit counts the mesh's prisms and pyramids against the census (CensusMatchesMesh), never gated; the physical gates (positive orientation and Jacobian condition for every element type, scaled Jacobian for tetrahedra, corner aspect, protected surfaces, ownership closure, element cap) are unchanged
DesignGate.Rationale: a tetrahedral band anisotropy statistic has no meaning next to a prism tube (200:1 prisms by design); the metal-edge resolution is the tube record itself
